about.text: A cheese produced in Sweden from moose milk

sources.text: Made from moose milk (not in the milk enum). Three styles at Älgens Hus, Bjurholm: rind-style, blue and feta-style, so not one cheese type; roughly 300 kg a year. Also made in Russia by GamEat
